description: Two-layer support stand (rigid weldment, no movable joints). Two posts 220 mm apart and 190 mm tall, bridged by a tall rear plate and two horizontal shelves (lower ~70 mm, upper ~170 mm). Bolts to the floor through foot plates with 4x Oe6.5 mm mounting holes. Authored by articraft from 2-layer-supporter.png; kinematics (none) live in model.urdf, this metadata carries only RoboSmith semantic annotations. Static support fixture, not a graspable target.

upright.description: stand upright on its foot plates, open shelf side facing +X toward the workspace

mounting_holes.note: floor mounting through foot plates; not subtracted from primitive geometry
